answer_summary: CO2 + 2 H+ + 2 e- -> CO + H2O; the equation conserves C, H, O, and charge and consumes exactly two electrons.
assumptions: Chemical formula semantics: subscripts give atom counts, H+ has charge +1, and e- has charge -1.
Atoms and electric charge are conserved when balancing a half-equation.
The allowed acidic-medium balancing species are H+, H2O, and e-, and the equation is normalized to one CO2.
